seasons.name: Miniseries
seasons.overview: Through a combination of bad luck and a bad temper, working-class moving man Pepper finds himself wrongfully committed to New Hyde Psychiatric Hospital - an institution filled with those society would rather forget. There, he must contend with patients working against him, doctors harboring grim secrets, and perhaps even the Devil himself. As Pepper navigates a hellscape where nothing is as it seems, he finds that the only path to freedom is to face the entity which thrives on the suffering within New Hyde's walls - but doing so may prove that the worst demons of all live inside him.

reviews.author: JuanPabloMontaya
reviews.content:
Dan Stevens and Judith Light are apparently the only people who were professional actors on this show. The supporting actors were laughably bad, but hey go figure. Also the writing was suspect initially until it turned outright atrocious the last few episodes. How many people were paid for this series? What a joke. 

Also, this is a bit meta, but lately I tend to trust this website more than others for honest reviews and numerical rankings. This isn't the case for this show. For some reason the other big websites have this awful series ranked far more appropriately, meaning it's much lower on every other website. I guess maybe there's a few people on this site who are 'positive review bombing' this absolute train wreck of a tv series. Seems like a stupid waste of time to me, but again, go figure.
